author: Luska
text: Thank you for the appreciations and inspirations. Ranks doesnt mean anything to me. It doesnt matter where i am in the ranks. Most important thing is not my skill. I just wanna prove that its not how hard you fall. Its how hard you came back after the fall. Dont give up on what you started. Why start at the very first place if so. The person who makes me keep going is Donald Trumph. Although he had personal debts of over $200m, he refuses to quit and look where he is today. Skill wise evryone will develop their own unique skill as time goes by. The fundamental and understanding is more important. Keep fighting!!!
